result.summary: The layout is mostly coherent, but several elements are clipped or truncated at container edges and there is inconsistent styling between repeated card components. Found 5 issues: 1 major text truncation/overlap, plus layout and styling inconsistencies.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' in the 'Popular right now' card is clipped/cut off mid-glyph by the rating block on the right, with no ellipsis or spacing between the two elements.
issues.suggestion: Give the title a flexible width with text-overflow: ellipsis and reserve fixed space for the rating, adding a gap between title and rating so characters are never visually sliced.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel ('Trattoria Piccol...') is hard-clipped at the right screen edge, and its name is cut mid-word without ellipsis, making it look broken rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent horizontal padding/peek to the carousel so the next card is partially but cleanly visible, and truncate card titles with an ellipsis.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) buttons use inconsistent styling: the ramen card has a white circular background while the pizza card below uses a dark/translucent background.
issues.suggestion: Standardise the favorite button background, size and icon colour across all cards.

issues.description: The category filter chip row is cut off at the right edge, showing only a thin sliver of the next chip, which reads as a rendering glitch.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the scroll container padding so the next chip is either meaningfully visible or fully off-screen, and consider a fade/gradient affordance.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card is abruptly cut by the bottom navigation bar with no fade or visible partial content cue, and its text/rating are hidden behind the nav.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scroll content equal to the nav bar height so cards can scroll fully clear of the tab bar.
